summary.text: Carrie Semmelroth represents Idaho Senate District 17 and works in higher education; the Idaho Legislature's member page lists a third term.

paragraphs.text: The legislature biography says Semmelroth was raised in Boise, has served in education since 2003, and holds an Idaho teaching certification as an Exceptional Child Generalist (K-12).
The biography lists an Ed.D. in curriculum and instruction with a special education emphasis from Boise State University (2013).
